item.title: This Just Isn’t Coworking Out, Part 2
item.description: Read This Just Isn’t Coworking Out, Part 2 And then in the middle of a particularly nasty day, at the end of ringing a customer up and reaching down for a bag to put his stuff in, [Coworker] decides to hip-check me out of the way. Literally. Now this woman was easily twice my size, and I almost fell on my face when she moved into my space behind the register I was using. Read This Just Isn’t Coworking Out, Part 2

item.title: Oh Boy, Not Again…
item.description: Read Oh Boy, Not Again… Me: "Is this for a gender reveal cake?" Woman: "Yup!" Guy: "Hoping for a boy this time!" Me: "Is it all girls so far?" Guy: *Pained look.* "…yeah." Read Oh Boy, Not Again…

item.title: Know Your Worth, And Worthless Managers
item.description: Read Know Your Worth, And Worthless Managers Manager: "[My Name], are you busy right now?" Me: "You assigned me two large pieces of work this morning on top of my regular monthly report, so what do you think?" Manager: "No need to be so sassy." Read Know Your Worth, And Worthless Managers

item.title: The Mother Of All Deadlines
item.description: Read The Mother Of All Deadlines I pulled up to a regular pizza customer's house and knocked on the door. Rather than the usual Dad customer I share a little small talk with, it's the Mom who comes to the door. She reaches for the table to get the cash (where it usually is when this household orders), but it's gone. Customer: "Just a sec!" Read The Mother Of All Deadlines

item.title: UK Is Not OK, Part 2
item.description: Read UK Is Not OK, Part 2 Caller: "You keep saying that. What's the United Kingdom?" Me: "It's a country in Europe, ma'am." Caller: "…" Me: "Great Britain? The British? Uh… England?" Read UK Is Not OK, Part 2
